English: Slope Shelter
A basic collection of hide tents and windbreaks, hastily erected on the hillside for immediate shelter and protection against the elements.
Terraced Pen
Stone-lined animal pens and simple terracing to prevent erosion, supporting herd growth and basic food stability.
Hilltop Watch
A crude wooden lookout platform atop the hill, manned by sentries to warn of approaching threats and raiders.
Reinforced Hill Camp
Earthen ramparts, ditches, and timber supports surround the camp, making it harder for enemies and the elements to threaten the nomads.
Embankment Pavilion
A complex of pavilions and command tents, surrounded by sturdy earth embankments and guarded entrances. Designed for larger gatherings and strategic defense.
Hillside Stockade
A wooden stockade rises atop the hill, with watch posts and reinforced gates, offering serious resistance to invaders and a symbol of clan unity.
Raised Palisade
A double-ring of high timber palisades, with raised walkways and arrow slits, allowing for improved defense and coordination of the horde.
Lookout Ridge
A fortified ridge, ringed by palisades and topped with watchtowers, gives unprecedented visibility and coordination to the nomad horde.
Hillside Bastion
Stone bastions and reinforced towers line the camp, with permanent garrisons and communal halls for the warrior elite.
Hill Fortress
An immense stone fortress dominates the hillside, with layered defenses, storerooms, and permanent quarters for the entire clan. A symbol of unbreakable strength.
